Appearance

Small halfling in oversized robes and a floppy hat, usually buried in half-open textbooks.

What We Know

Evocation wizard at the Highreach Wizard's Tower. Seems perpetually busy with research. Known to be vocal about things that bother him.

First Impressions

Bookish and a bit prickly — has opinions and isn't shy about sharing them.

Interactions

  • Met at the Wizard's Tower — shared info on the Seeker's Eye
  • Party sent Goldman's repair bill to Jon — he sent it right back
  • Told the party the legend of Diego and the lich's sealed artifacts
